title: Finding and trying Arduino IDE and ESP32 examples

spans.text: Arduino IDE's File → Examples lists examples from installed libraries and board packages. Blink, Button, AnalogReadSerial, and Wire.begin are useful first checks.
After installing the ESP32 Arduino core, explore GPIO, WiFiScan, Preferences, and Deep Sleep under File → Examples → ESP32. ESP-IDF examples use a separate project and build system.
Open an example, select the board and port, read its pin/library requirements, then upload it unchanged first. Check LED_BUILTIN on UNO and the actual LED pin on ESP32 boards.

spans.title: Important safety note
spans.text: LED GPIOs, Wi-Fi, and peripherals vary by board. Adapt examples to the selected board and library version.
